findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Raise: Security. A pull request author can place a deeply nested JSON value in the hidden time record while keeping the body well below GitHub's size limit. `json.loads` raises `RecursionError` at sufficient nesting depth, but this parser does not catch it. Reading that pull request then crashes `forge board` or `forge next` instead of treating the record as malformed.
findings.title: Deeply nested pull request records can crash board and next

findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Item 12 remains incomplete here: the board retains the old counts and page, blocking plan problems are absent from Needs you, and pane times remain abbreviated. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. On a repeat close that hits a default-branch conflict, this call publishes a fabricated `reviewing` result with empty findings and evidence. `_publish` replaces the PR's managed block, so a blocked review loses its findings and proof list and appears to be running after close has stopped.
findings.title: A merge conflict replaces an existing PR's review and proof

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. The board passes part and read intervals plus the story start to `time_records.story`, but supplies no completion bound when `unfinished` is false. If `forge story done` records the outcome after the last part merges, that elapsed time is omitted from the story's unknown seconds and total. The added runway test covers an unfinished story.
findings.title: Completed stories omit elapsed time after their last part

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Item 12 remains incomplete in this branch: the board retains its old counts and card page, blocking plan problems are absent from Needs you, and the pane still uses abbreviated times. The pinned folding sections, story keys and cold-read history are also absent. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12
